message.content: - 单个罪名: [罪名]交通肇事罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime based on facts: driver of excavator (铲车) at construction site, while reversing, negligently hits a motorcyclist (riding electric bike) causing death. This is likely "交通肇事罪" (traffic accident causing death) under Chinese criminal law, article 133. Could also be "过失致人死亡" under article 233? Actually article 133 is "交通肇事罪" for causing death, serious injury, or major property loss due to traffic accident. Since the vehicle is a construction vehicle on site, but still a motor vehicle. So crime: 交通肇事罪.

Thus answer: [罪名]交通肇事罪<eoa>
